# External samples

Source: DeepMind CodeContests (Hugging Face: deepmind/code_contests), training split.
Imported with backend/tools/import_codecontests.py (seed 42, first 1500 problems,
single-algorithm-tag filter, C++ only, <=80 lines, no #define, compiles with g++ -std=c++17).
Hashing samples removed. Labels come from Codeforces problem tags.
License: see the dataset card on Hugging Face.
